body_es: El rebase es una alternativa a la fusión que reescribe el historial de commits para que sea lineal. Toma los commits de una rama y los aplica encima de otra. Produce un historial más limpio que una fusión tradicional, pero modifica los hashes de commit. El rebase es ideal para ramas locales antes de compartirlas; nunca se debe hacer rebase en commits que ya han sido publicados.
body_en: Rebase is an alternative to merging that rewrites commit history to be linear. It takes commits from one branch and applies them on top of another. It produces a cleaner history than a traditional merge, but modifies commit hashes. Rebase is ideal for local branches before sharing them; you should never rebase commits that have already been published.
example_code:
git checkout feature/new-api
git rebase master
# Resolve any conflicts if they arise
git rebase --continue
git log --oneline
example_output:
Current branch feature/new-api is up to date.
Successfully rebased and updated refs/heads/feature/new-api.
